scientific_integrity: The complete signed Fourier formula, proof of the exact vanishing frequencies, rank count and asymptotic are self-contained. Exact direct-frequency computations verify by a separate direct enumeration of 29,520 frequencies for n=2,...,9.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the nowhere-zero three-element group flows on a two-vertex graph with parallel edges, not arbitrary finite groups or graphs.
No optimal positive-subspace singular-value bound or claim of priority for MacWilliams character identities.
Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: A three-step singularity law for ternary nowhere-zero flow convolution
